name: Jalapeno Popper Chicken Casserole
ingredients_verbatim: 2 lb chicken breasts, cooked and chopped
1/2 cup jalapeno or poblano pepper, seeded and diced
1 thinly sliced and seeded jalapeno (optional, topping)
unmapped: shredded cheddar cheese (board has only cheddar-cheese-curds and vegan daiya-cheddar-style-shreds, no plain shredded cheddar id)
why: Oven-baked chicken casserole bound by cream cheese, sour cream and cheddar (no pasta/rice/potato), published 418 cal / 30g protein / 2g carbs per serving - comfortably inside the 400-650 cal, <=35g carb band with excellent protein-to-calorie density and rock-bottom carbs. Whole-muscle chicken breast, batch-scalable to 14 as a weigh-and-divide bake. Distinct from the run's chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower bake (no ranch, no cauliflower; jalapeno-forward Tex-Mex).
